keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

highlights.title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
highlights.authors: Javad Amirian, Armin Kiani, Loic Schaeffer et al.
highlights.theme: Embodied robot learning and interactive world models
highlights.why: Releases HubEgo-100K, a 10,124-hour egocentric video dataset of skilled work with synchronized IMU across diverse environments, directly addressing robot learning generalization needs.
highlights.key_result: HubEgo-100K v1.0 is an in-the-wild egocentric video dataset of skilled work built for diversity: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz IMU data from one head-mounted phone camera, recorded by 12,227 contributors in 15,548 environments, and released as 72,754 episodes under CC BY 4.0.
evidence: We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera.

In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings.
The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0.

highlights.authors: Allen G. Roush, Minh Nhat Nguyen, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv et al.
highlights.why: Argues long-context generation quality is determined primarily by the sampler at high temperature, showing samplers that keep candidate pools steady maintain accuracy across many benchmarks.

highlights.authors: Sikun Xu, Raphael Thomadsen, Dennis J. Zhang et al.
highlights.theme: Benchmark validity, leaderboard auditing, and multimodal reasoning evaluation
highlights.why: Introduces a bootstrap correction for leaderboard winner's curse, showing top-ranked model scores are overstated by up to 3.86 points across 14 benchmarks, which undermines leaderboard trust.
highlights.key_result: The paper develops an m-out-of-N bootstrap to correct for leaderboard rank-induced bias; under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, it proves that the bootstrap reduces (N^-1/2) ranking bias to expected residual bias o(N^-1/2). news.summary: Google announced that Gemini can handle tasks such as scheduling appointments, analyzing utility bills, and purchasing items by connecting to email, calendar, and payment methods in hardware-isolated virtual machines. The update rolls out free using the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model across the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India, with advanced features starting in the U.S.; examples include calling two dealerships and booking an appointment in under five minutes and analyzing a $389 electric bill.

news.title: Can AI help build a healthier future?
news.summary: A Microsoft Research podcast episode of The Shape of Things to Come features Doug Burger with Ava Amini, Eric Horvitz, and Eric Topol discussing AI-assisted medical diagnosis, medical imaging, whole-patient models, virtual cells, and biological foundation models. It also covers why promising research is slow to reach patients, AI-guided experiments and drug discovery, and the need for better biological data and real-world validation.

news.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
news.summary: At SC26, NVIDIA's Ian Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU, an expanded Vera CPU platform, and a quantum computing collaboration with IBM and Fermilab. Nemotron combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with an open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes; examples included an Argonne agent identifying two new binding sites and a GROMACS agent fixing 81% of test cases overnight on one DGX Spark, while Rubin HPC has more than 50,000 CUDA cores and is expected in 2028.

news.title: Co-Designing Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
news.summary: An NVIDIA Developer post presents co-design guidelines for model-level sparse attention on GPUs, where an indexer scores all keys and Top-k selects a subset before core attention; at 128K tokens the indexer and Top-k take 47% of the DeepSeek V3.2 prefill layer. It recommends KH=1 with cross-head reduction, indexer head dimensions of 128 or 256, FP16 epilogue and accumulation, fusing Top-k into the indexer kernel, and reusing the previous decode step's selection, which accelerates Top-k by 2.1x to 2.4x.

news.title: Integrating QPUs into Supercomputing Centers Using Slurm HRES Plugins
news.summary: Slurm 26.11 introduces Hierarchical Resources plugins that model quantum processing units as native, cluster-level schedulable resources, associating a QPU with the specific nodes allowed to use it. A short Lua plugin handles device health checks, job admission before node allocation, and resource release, while site-specific policies stay in resources.yaml; QRMI and QDMI have released HRES plugins connecting Slurm clusters to quantum computers from multiple providers.

news.title: Managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference now supports managed NVIDIA Dynamo, enabling multi-node deployment, disaggregated prefill and decode, and KV-aware routing with engines such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM, backed by EFA networking, GPU scheduling, and node health monitoring. The post cites GLM-5.3's FP8 weights exceeding the 640 GB of GPU memory on a single ml.p5.48xlarge instance and describes configuration through InferenceEndpointConfig dynamoSpec and DynamoGraphDeployment.

news.title: Reducing token costs and latency in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore JSON workloads
news.summary: AWS describes three composable strategies used to build a Flightscape production agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that handles 20 MB+ JSON payloads with 40+ tools, after average request latencies exceeded 15 seconds. The optimizations reduced token consumption by up to 71% and average latency by up to 80% on a representative 23 MB payload.

news.title: Cut generative AI costs: Code for rules, models for judgment
news.summary: AWS outlines a decision framework for generative AI workflows that asks whether a step needs a model at all, using deterministic code when a rule can check success, a model to write a rule once, or a constrained decision call when choosing from a fixed list, and a right-sized Amazon Bedrock model only for open-ended steps. A customer support example maps five steps to API Gateway or Lambda validation, Step Functions JSONata routing, a committed regex in Lambda, constrained decision calls, and a right-sized Bedrock model.

news.title: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache aware routing
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache-aware routing, which uses container-reported cache events and a managed index of truncated hashes to send requests to instances with the longest cached prompt match while weighing instance load. It is enabled by setting SM_VLLM_KV_EVENTS_CONFIG on the model and RoutingStrategy to KV_AWARE in the endpoint configuration, with clients using the same APIs as before.

highlights.key_result: HubEgo-100K v1.0 是一个面向多样性的野外第一人称技能工作视频数据集：10,124小时1080p第一人称视频，带有来自一个头戴式手机摄像头的同步100 Hz IMU数据，由12,227名贡献者在15,548个环境中录制，并以CC BY 4.0许可证发布为72,754个片段。
evidence: We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera.

In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings.
The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0.

highlights.title: CrisisBench: an evaluation suite for crisis counseling AI
highlights.authors: Akshay Swaminathan, Filip Ramazan, Sharang Phadke et al.
highlights.theme: Clinical AI benchmarks, privacy, and medical imaging
highlights.why: 提出了CrisisBench，一个面向危机咨询AI的隐私保护评估套件，包含校准的患者模型和专家对齐的评分标准，揭示了安全与风险处理方面的不足。
highlights.key_result: 我们评估了五个GPT模型以及先草稿后编辑和检索增强生成；在单轮评估中，所有系统在过度共情和提问方面均不如人类咨询师。在多轮评估中，检索增强生成总体得分最高（0.961），所有系统差距在0.058以内。
evidence: We evaluated five GPT models plus draft-then-edit and retrieval-augmented generation. All systems underperformed human counselors on excessive empathy and questioning in single-turn evaluation.
In multi-turn evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation scored highest overall (0.961), with all systems within 0.058.

highlights.title: Auditors Struggle to Catch Sabotage In End-to-End Transcripts of AI Safety Research
highlights.authors: Keshav Shenoy, Anthony Zang, Eric Gan et al.
highlights.theme: LLM safety alignment, refusal, watermarking, and guardrails
highlights.why: 报告称人类审计员在检测安全研究破坏方面AUROC为0.59，被前沿模型超越，表明当前审计方法存在严重局限。
highlights.key_result: 人类审计员大多无法区分被破坏的研究与良性研究，AUROC为0.59，并不显著优于随机，且仅在17%的案例中完全识别出具体破坏；最好的前沿模型在噪声范围内优于人类审计员（Fable 5.1：AUROC 0.73，32%完全识别）。
evidence: Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases.
Despite not being allowed to run experiments, the best frontier models outperform human auditors (Fable 5.1: AUROC 0.73, 32% full identification) within noise and weaker models perform comparably.

highlights.title: Lost in a Few Heads: Diagnosing and Repairing Block Selection in Sparse Attention
highlights.theme: Efficient LLM inference, serving, quantization, and speculative decoding
highlights.why: 将稀疏注意力失败诊断为在特定盲头中对针的排序不足，并表明全注意力或4-bit评分器可以在不训练的情况下恢复大部分准确率。
highlights.key_result: 在MiniCPM4.1-8B上，上下文长度64K时，任一修复都将多键检索准确率从54.1提升到97.5%，与每个头中的全注意力持平。在生产服务引擎中，在这些头中使用全注意力可以保留稀疏注意力在32K至128K上下文长度下节省的84%到89%的首token时间（TTFT）。
evidence: On MiniCPM4.1-8B at 64K, either fix lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 54.1 to 97.5%, level with full attention in every head.
In production serving engines, full attention in those heads keeps 84 to 89% of the time to first token (TTFT) that sparse attention saves at 32K to 128K context length.

highlights.title: Eight in Ten LLMs Leak System-Prompt Secrets: Nevan, an Agentic Capture-the-Flag Study

evidence: The flag was exfiltrated from 296 of the 363 models, plus four models released after the initial catalog freeze, for 300 captures in total. Of these, 170 involved a non-English language pivot, most often French.

The audit answers it for the frozen catalog: 296 of 363 entries were captured, plus four bonus captures on models released after the freeze, for 300 total. Of the 300, 170 involved a non-English language pivot, 119 of them French.

highlights.title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
highlights.authors: Elaine Lau, Antoine Pangas, Alexandre Finot et al.
highlights.theme: Agent harnesses, coding benchmarks, and enterprise evaluation
highlights.why: 引入了ATLAS-Finance，100个跨模拟公司的现实投行任务，其中顶级智能体的任务通过率低于11%，暴露出巨大的企业能力差距。
highlights.key_result: 尽管完成了所请求工作的大部分，当前智能体很少产出正确的交付物。在当今前沿模型中，最好的模型（Claude Opus和Fable）通过的任务不到11%。
evidence: Despite completing substantial portions of the requested work, current agents rarely produce correct deliverables. Across today's frontier models, the best ones (Claude Opus and Fable) pass fewer than 11% of tasks.

highlights.title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
highlights.authors: Allen G. Roush, Minh Nhat Nguyen, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv et al.
highlights.why: 认为长上下文生成质量主要由高温下的采样器决定，表明保持候选池稳定的采样器在多个基准上保持准确率。
highlights.key_result: 在29个模型和所有尝试的基准上，候选集保持小而稳定的采样器在高温下损失很小或没有损失，而接纳尾部候选的采样器则崩溃。在所有基准上，top-n保持了其temperature-1得分的100%中位数，而top-p仅保持26%。
evidence: Across 29 models and every benchmark tried, samplers whose candidate set stays small and stable lose little or nothing at high temperature, and samplers that admit the tail fall apart.
Over all benchmarks top-n keeps a median 100% of its temperature-1 score where top-p keeps 26%.

highlights.title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
highlights.authors: Sikun Xu, Raphael Thomadsen, Dennis J. Zhang et al.
highlights.theme: Benchmark validity, leaderboard auditing, and multimodal reasoning evaluation
highlights.why: 提出了一种针对排行榜“赢家诅咒”的bootstrap校正，表明在14个基准上排名靠前的模型分数被高估最多3.86个百分点，这削弱了排行榜的可信度。
highlights.key_result: 本文提出了一种m-out-of-N bootstrap来校正排行榜排名引起的偏差；在由正间隔分隔的精确总体层级下，证明了bootstrap将(N^-1/2)的排名偏差降至期望残差偏差o(N^-1/2)。在来自5个基准家族的14个基准上，排名第一的调整幅度范围约为0.09到3.86个百分点，在SWE-bench Verified快照中，并列领先者获得0.90个百分点的调整。
evidence: Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces (N^-1/2) ranking bias to expected residual bias o(N^-1/2).
Across 14 benchmarks from 5 benchmark families, the rank-1 adjustments range from approximately 0.09 to 3.86 percentage points.
In our SWE-bench Verified snapshot, the tied leaders receive an adjustment of 0.90 percentage points.

news.title: Can AI help build a healthier future?
news.summary: Microsoft Research播客《The Shape of Things to Come》的一集邀请Doug Burger与Ava Amini、Eric Horvitz和Eric Topol讨论AI辅助医疗诊断、医学影像、全患者模型、虚拟细胞和生物基础模型。它还讨论了为什么有前景的研究转化为患者应用缓慢、AI引导的实验和药物发现，以及需要更好的生物数据和真实世界验证。

news.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
news.summary: 在SC26上，NVIDIA的Ian Buck宣布了用于科学的Nemotron、Rubin HPC GPU、扩展的Vera CPU平台以及与IBM和Fermilab的量子计算合作。Nemotron将Nemotron 3.5 Super VL开放模型与开放化学数据集和后训练配方相结合；例子包括一个Argonne智能体识别出两个新的结合位点，以及一个GROMACS智能体在一个DGX Spark上一夜修复了81%的测试用例，而Rubin HPC拥有超过50,000个CUDA核心，预计于2028年推出。

news.title: Co-Designing Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
news.summary: 一篇NVIDIA Developer文章提出了GPU上模型级稀疏注意力的协同设计指南，其中索引器对所有键评分，Top-k在核心注意力之前选择一个子集；在128K token时，索引器和Top-k占DeepSeek V3.2 prefill层的47%。它建议KH=1并进行跨头归约，索引器头维度为128或256，FP16 epilogue和累加，将Top-k融合到索引器kernel中，并复用前一个解码步骤的选择，这将Top-k加速2.1倍到2.4倍。

news.title: Integrating QPUs into Supercomputing Centers Using Slurm HRES Plugins
news.summary: Slurm 26.11引入了Hierarchical Resources插件，将量子处理单元建模为原生的集群级可调度资源，将QPU与允许使用它的特定节点关联。一个简短的Lua插件处理设备健康检查、节点分配前的作业准入和资源释放，而站点特定策略保留在resources.yaml中；QRMI和QDMI已发布HRES插件，将Slurm集群连接到来自多个供应商的量子计算机。

news.title: Managed NVIDIA Dynamo on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference现在支持托管的NVIDIA Dynamo，支持多节点部署、解耦的prefill和decode，以及使用vLLM、SGLang和TensorRT-LLM等引擎的KV感知路由，并由EFA网络、GPU调度和节点健康监控提供支持。该文章提到GLM-5.3的FP8权重超过了单个ml.p5.48xlarge实例上640 GB的GPU内存，并描述了通过InferenceEndpointConfig dynamoSpec和DynamoGraphDeployment进行配置。

news.title: Reducing token costs and latency in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore JSON workloads
news.summary: AWS描述了三种可组合策略，用于在Amazon Bedrock AgentCore上构建Flightscape生产智能体，该智能体在平均请求延迟超过15秒后，处理20 MB以上、40多个工具的JSON负载。这些优化在代表性23 MB负载上将token消耗降低最多71%，平均延迟降低最多80%。

news.title: Cut generative AI costs: Code for rules, models for judgment
news.summary: AWS概述了一个生成式AI工作流的决策框架，该框架询问某一步骤是否真的需要模型，在规则可以检查成功时使用确定性代码，使用模型一次性编写规则，或在从固定列表中选择时使用受限决策调用，并且仅在开放式步骤中使用合适规模的Amazon Bedrock模型。一个客户支持示例将五个步骤映射到API Gateway或Lambda验证、Step Functions JSONata路由、Lambda中固定的regex、受限决策调用以及合适规模的Bedrock模型。

news.title: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache aware routing
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI实时端点现在支持KV缓存感知路由，它使用容器报告的缓存事件和截断哈希的托管索引，将请求发送到具有最长缓存提示匹配的实例，同时权衡实例负载。通过在模型上设置SM_VLLM_KV_EVENTS_CONFIG并在端点配置中将RoutingStrategy设置为KV_AWARE来启用，客户端使用与之前相同的API。
